Why it matters

  • One agent is a tool. Ten agents on one repo is a team.
  • Today they find out at merge time. Weft moves it to edit time.
  • In two weeks: 39 stars · a stranger filed 22 issues & PRs · the Beads team asked how to integrate
  • Next: a Time Machine for agent work. Previews per revision exist; the timeline isn't built yet.
